items.title: 9.8.1 Applications of solubility product (solubility product ke istemal) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.8.1, printed pages 202-204, with Quick Check 9.5 as self-checks.

blocks.text: a) Determination of Solubility from Ksp (Ksp se solubility nikalna)

Is ke liye compound ka formula aur us ki Ksp value chahiye. Phir unknown (namaloom) molar solubility S nikali jati hai aur ions ki concentrations maloom ho jati hain. Table 9.6 kuch kam ghulne wale compounds ki Ksp aur solubility ka relation dikhati hai.

blocks.caption: Table 9.6 Kuch salts ki solubility aur solubility product

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab mein PbSO₄ ka Ksp 1.69 x 10⁻⁴ chhapa hai; sahi 1.69 × 10⁻⁸ hai ((1.3 × 10⁻⁴)² = 1.69 × 10⁻⁸; text aur Table 9.5 bhi 1.6 × 10⁻⁸ deti hain). Aakhri column ki unit “g dm⁻³” chhapi hai; yeh values asal mein mol dm⁻³ mein hain.

blocks.title: Sample Problem
blocks.problem: Ca(OH)₂ kam ghulne wala compound hai; Ksp = 6.5 × 10⁻⁶. Ca(OH)₂ ki solubility nikalein.
steps: Solubility ko S mol dm⁻³ maan lein.
Shuru mein: Ca²⁺ = 0, OH⁻ = 0. Equilibrium par: Ca²⁺ = S, OH⁻ = 2S (har Ca(OH)₂ se do OH⁻)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne equilibrium stage par “S + S” likha hai; OH⁻ ki concentration 2S honi chahiye (agli line bhi (2S)² istemal karti hai). Kitab Ca(OH)₂ ko (aq) bhi likhti hai; bina ghula salt solid (s) hai.
Is tarah Ca(OH)₂ ke solubility product se Ca²⁺ aur OH⁻ dono ki alag alag concentrations nikal aayin.
b) Common Ion Effect (common ion ka asar)
Common ion ki presence (maujoodgi) kam ghulne wale ionic compound ki solubility kam kar deti hai. Samajhne ke liye PbCrO₄ ka saturated solution lein, jo kam ghulne wala salt hai.

Ab is mein Na₂CrO₄ dalein, jo khoob ghulne wala salt hai. CrO₄²⁻ common ion hai. Yeh Pb²⁺ se mil kar aur PbCrO₄ banata hai jo nahi ghulta. Ksp ko constant rakhne ke liye equilibrium baen taraf (left) chala jata hai.
c) Predicting Precipitation (precipitate banega ya nahi, andaza lagana)

Solubility product se yeh bhi andaza lagta hai ke kisi salt ka precipitate banega ya nahi. Example: CaSO₄ ka Ksp 2 × 10⁻⁵ hai. 25°C par 10⁻² mol dm⁻³ Ca²⁺ ka solution 10⁻² mol dm⁻³ SO₄²⁻ ke solution mein (barabar volume) milayen to milane se har ion ki concentration aadhi ho jati hai:

blocks.text_alt: [Ca²⁺] = [SO₄²⁻] = 10⁻²/2 = 5.0 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³; [Ca²⁺][SO₄²⁻] = 5.0 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³ × 5.0 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³ = 2.5 × 10⁻⁵ mol² dm⁻⁶ > Ksp of CaSO₄

blocks.text: Concentrations ka product (ionic product) Ksp se zyada hai, is liye CaSO₄ precipitate ho jayega.

blocks.prompt: a) AgCl ka Ksp 25°C par 1.77 × 10⁻¹⁰ hai. 0.10 M NaCl wale solution mein AgCl ki solubility nikalein.
blocks.explanation: NaCl se [Cl⁻] = 0.10 M aata hai. Ksp = [Ag⁺][Cl⁻] = S × 0.10, to S = 1.77 × 10⁻¹⁰ / 0.10 = 1.8 × 10⁻⁹ mol dm⁻³. Pure pani mein S = √(1.77 × 10⁻¹⁰) = 1.3 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ hoti; common ion ne solubility bohat ghata di.

blocks.prompt: b) 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³ Ca²⁺ aur 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³ SO₄²⁻ milaye jayen to CaSO₄ precipitate hoga ya nahi?
blocks.explanation: Barabar volume milane se har concentration 5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ ho jati hai. Ionic product = (5 × 10⁻⁴)² = 2.5 × 10⁻⁷, jo Ksp = 2 × 10⁻⁵ se kam hai. Solution unsaturated hai, precipitate nahi banega.

blocks.prompt: c) Ammonium oxalate ka aqueous solution acidic hoga ya basic? Equation se explain karein.
blocks.explanation: (NH₄)₂C₂O₄ weak base NH₃ aur weak acid oxalic acid ka salt hai, is liye dono ions hydrolyse hote hain: NH₄⁺ + H₂O ⇌ NH₃ + H₃O⁺ aur C₂O₄²⁻ + H₂O ⇌ HC₂O₄⁻ + OH⁻. Oxalic acid, ammonia ke base hone ke muqable mein, zyada strong acid hai; is liye oxalate kam hydrolyse hota hai aur solution halka sa acidic hota hai (topic 9.8.4).

blocks.prompt: d) Potassium carbonate ka solution basic hai. (i) Alkaline kyun hai? (ii) Hydrolysis ki equation dein.
blocks.explanation: (i) K₂CO₃ se K⁺ aur CO₃²⁻ bante hain. K⁺ strong base KOH ka conjugate acid hai aur pani se react nahi karta, lekin CO₃²⁻ weak acid HCO₃⁻ ka conjugate base hai aur pani se proton leta hai, jis se OH⁻ banta hai. (ii) CO₃²⁻ + H₂O ⇌ HCO₃⁻ + OH⁻ (topic 9.8.3).

blocks.title: Interesting Information! (dilchasp maloomat!)
blocks.text: Nautilus ka shell (khol) zyada tar calcium carbonate ka bana hota hai. Nautilus conditions aisi rakhta hai ke jab sea (samandar) ke pani mein calcium ions aur carbonate ions ki concentration itni ho jaye ke calcium carbonate precipitate ho sake, tab shell ka material banta hai (yani ionic product Ksp se barh jaye).

items: Ksp se solubility: Ca(OH)₂ ke liye 4S³ = 6.5 × 10⁻⁶ → S = 1.18 × 10⁻² mol dm⁻³, [OH⁻] = 2.36 × 10⁻² mol dm⁻³.
Common ion solubility ghatata hai: PbCrO₄ mein Na₂CrO₄ dalne se equilibrium baen taraf.
Precipitate tab banta hai jab ionic product > Ksp (CaSO₄: 2.5 × 10⁻⁵ > 2 × 10⁻⁵).
